name: LimeSurvey
description_en:
LimeSurvey is survey software available as a managed Cloud service and a downloadable Community Edition (CE). It supports structured questionnaires, branching, multilingual surveys, participant administration and analysis/export. The two operating models share a product lineage but have different responsibility and cost boundaries.

Community Edition is open-source software under GPL version 2 or later according to the repository license. Running it yourself still requires hosting, database, mail delivery, updates and backups. A Cloud response quota is not a limit imposed on every self-hosted installation, and free source code does not mean free managed hosting.
description_zh:
LimeSurvey 提供托管 Cloud 服务和可下载 Community Edition（CE），支持结构化问卷、分支、多语言问卷、参与者管理及分析／导出。两种运行模式同源，但责任和成本边界不同。

仓库许可确认 CE 为 GPL 第 2 版或更新版本的开源软件。自行运行仍需托管、数据库、邮件、升级与备份。Cloud 回答额度不是所有自托管安装的通用限制，源代码免费也不等于托管服务免费。

core_features.explanation_zh: 定价功能表描述矩阵、配额、分支、引用与多语言问卷。

core_features.explanation_en: Supports invitations/reminders and exports for common statistical tools.
core_features.explanation_zh: 支持邀请／提醒及常用统计工具导出。

Research scope.en: Public documentation and commercial access reviewed; examples are proposed evaluation workflows.

target_audience.organization_sizes_en: Select by workflow, volume and governance needs; no universal size claim.

steps.en: Cloud removes installation and update work from the customer. CE requires a compatible PHP version, supported database and extensions. The installation manual currently distinguishes PHP requirements for 7.x and 6.x; choose the intended release before provisioning. Prepare the database user, writable upload/tmp/config paths and mail configuration, then test restoration and invitations before a real study. This research installed nothing and changed no database.
steps.zh: Cloud 将安装和更新交由供应方。CE 需要兼容 PHP、受支持数据库及扩展。安装手册当前区分 7.x 和 6.x 的 PHP 要求，应先选择版本再配置环境。准备数据库用户、upload／tmp／config 可写目录和邮件配置，再在真实研究前测试恢复与邀请。本研究没有安装软件或修改数据库。

items.en: The installation guide names missing runtime modules, permissions and database setup as concrete setup dependencies. Upload and export formats can depend on optional extensions. If installation fails, inspect version-specific requirements and errors rather than weakening permissions blindly. Questionnaire complexity, email delivery and restore capability need testing in your environment. No production-scale benchmark, backup restore or plugin compatibility test was performed.
items.zh: 安装指南明确列运行扩展、权限和数据库为实际依赖；上传与导出格式也可能依赖可选扩展。安装失败时应检查版本要求与报错，不应盲目放宽权限。问卷复杂度、邮件投递和恢复能力需在自己的环境测试。未做生产规模基准、备份恢复或插件兼容测试。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The retrieved localized page shows Basic equivalent to €26/month billed monthly with 1,000 responses/month and one admin; Expert €268/year with 10,000 responses/year and three admins; Business €693/year with 50,000 responses/year and a five-to-ten admin selector. Non-EUR displays are indicative and checkout is in EUR. Corporate is quoted. These are a dated localized snapshot, not every buyer’s quote. Free Cloud signup is advertised, but its current numerical response limit was not established. CE download is free; infrastructure and maintenance are additional operational costs.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 所读本地化页面显示 Basic 等值每月 26 欧元、按月付款，含每月 1,000 回答及一个管理员；Expert 每年 268 欧元、每年 10,000 回答及三名管理员；Business 每年 693 欧元、每年 50,000 回答及五至十名管理员选择。非欧元仅供参考，结账使用欧元。Corporate 询价。这是带日期的地区快照，不是所有买家的报价。宣传可免费注册 Cloud，但本次未建立其具体免费回答额度。CE 可免费下载，基础设施及维护另有运营成本。

sections.title_en: Prepare a controlled questionnaire and analysis dataset
sections.title_zh: 准备受控问卷与分析数据
sections.en: For an academic study, define the questionnaire, eligibility and analysis variables before implementing branches. Pilot each relevant path and export a few known responses into the intended analysis tool. Decide whether the study is public or uses participant invitations and whether identity must be separated from answers. Export availability is not a proof of anonymity. Version the questionnaire before full collection so later wording changes are visible in interpretation. This is editorial study-design guidance, not an executed LimeSurvey test.
sections.zh: 学术研究应先定义题目、资格及分析变量，再实现分支。试点每条相关路径，将已知回答导出到目标分析工具。决定公开参与或邀请参与，以及身份是否需与回答分离。能够导出不证明匿名。全面收集前记录问卷版本，避免后续措辞变化在解释时被忽略。这是编辑研究设计建议，未执行 LimeSurvey 测试。

sections.en: The repository LICENSE grants GPL-2.0-or-later redistribution/modification rights and disclaims warranty. This is a code-license observation, not legal advice about a particular redistribution. CE can fit teams needing server control and complex questionnaires; managed Cloud can fit teams that want the same category of survey work without administering the stack. Keep Cloud-only features, support and add-on costs distinct from CE rights.
sections.zh: 仓库 LICENSE 授予 GPL-2.0-or-later 的再分发／修改权利并声明无担保。这是代码许可观察，不是特定再分发行为的法律建议。需要服务器控制和复杂问卷的团队可评估 CE，希望免管技术栈的团队可评估托管 Cloud。Cloud 专属功能、支持和附加成本应与 CE 许可权利分开。
